author: sweeeper
body:
IT'S DONE! ... AGAIN! DOWNLOAD AND YAML IS READY!

Hello everyone!
 It's been a while since I last posted something here but I'm now back and I brought some goodies with me! Over the past few months I've been busy on building on my latest map, "Venator" (Hunter, or Huntsman in latin) . And last night I finally finished it!


More pictures:http://imgur.com/a/QQeqT
Download (rar): http://www.mediafire.com/download/1o12bdtvnosratg/Venator.rar
Download (zip): http://www.mediafire.com/download/81iwrguk6a7zz9k/Venator.zip
YAML: http://www.mediafire.com/download/ite97un439q6tyk/map.yml
YAML PASTEBIN: http://pastebin.com/KHsBxTyS

Venator is a large map with two teams (green and orange) with 6 monuments each, yes 6, your eyes are not deceiving you.
-"But how do we find all of the monuments!?" Each monument has it's own beacon connected to it. These beacons are 100% grief protected and you can not block the beacon beam with blocks. Another cool feature is that whenever a monument breaks, the beacon it's connected to will turn off!

There are three layers to this map, the main battle ground, the forest below and the floating islands above. I've learned from my experience of Proelium that it takes a loooong time to fall down, so I wanted to have something below the main battle ground to give players a second chance if they fall down.

Venator contains:
Diamonds
Gold
Iron
and lots of treasure chests. (There are pictures of some of the loot)
*coughs *eastereggs* coughs*

This map was built on alexanderjoe10's build server.

Resepignev is helping me making the YAML. THANK YOU!

!NOTE!: Do not save this map in 1.8 and open it in 1.7 it will mess up the chests and the signs.

love sweeeper <3
